tools.name: rate_my_team
tools.description: Use this when a Fantasy Premier League (FPL, fantasy football) manager wants their team rated or reviewed, or shares their team ID or FPL link without saying more. Scores the squad 0-100 against the best possible squad over the next 5 gameweeks and lists the biggest fixes, naming the players; pass their team ID or FPL link, or the player names read from a screenshot of their team.

team_id.description: The manager's FPL team ID (entry ID), or any FPL link containing /entry/<id>/. Leave empty if unknown.
team_id.title: Team Id

players.description: 11-15 FPL player names (e.g. read from a screenshot of their team), used when there is no team ID. Add the club to disambiguate, e.g. 'Palmer CHE'.
players.title: Players

tools.name: get_my_team
tools.description: Use this for start, bench and captain questions about an FPL manager's own squad: each player's fplcopilot expected points for the next gameweek with fixtures, and the best XI and captain. It shows the squad and does not score it. Needs their team ID or FPL link, or player names from a screenshot.

team_id.description: The manager's FPL team ID (entry ID), or any FPL link containing /entry/<id>/. Leave empty if unknown.
team_id.title: Team Id

players.description: 11-15 FPL player names (e.g. read from a screenshot of their team), used when there is no team ID. Add the club to disambiguate, e.g. 'Palmer CHE'.
players.title: Players

tools.name: get_captain_picks
tools.description: Use this when someone asks who to captain (or Triple Captain) in Fantasy Premier League (fantasy football) this gameweek. Call it even without their team: it then lists the best captain options in the game. With a team ID (or their team from an earlier chat) it ranks their own players; scope "all" ranks the game.

team_id.description: The manager's FPL team ID (entry ID), or any FPL link containing /entry/<id>/. Leave empty if unknown.
team_id.title: Team Id

scope.description: all: the best captains in the game, for general asks; squad: from the user's own team
scope.title: Scope

tools.name: find_players
tools.description: Use this to find the best Fantasy Premier League (fantasy football) players to pick or buy, by fplcopilot expected points (xPts, also called predicted or projected points), filtered by position, price, club or ownership, and sorted by points, value per £m, or as low-owned differentials. Classic FPL, not FPL Draft.

position.description: Position: GK, DEF, MID or FWD
position.title: Position

horizon.description: How many gameweeks ahead to count (1-8).
horizon.title: Horizon

tools.name: get_player
tools.description: Use this for one to five FPL players, e.g. whether to buy, sell or start them: expected points for each coming gameweek with fixtures, injury news, price and price-change progress, ownership, xG/xA and his chance of being the main penalty taker.

horizon.description: How many gameweeks ahead to count (1-8).
horizon.title: Horizon

tools.name: compare_players
tools.description: Use this when choosing between two or three FPL players (e.g. 'Saka or Palmer?', one transfer for another, or whether a -4 hit is worth it): expected points over the coming gameweeks, form, price and ownership side by side.

horizon.description: How many gameweeks ahead to count (1-8).
horizon.title: Horizon

tools.name: get_fixture_ticker
tools.description: Use this for Fantasy Premier League fixture difficulty (FDR) and which teams have the easiest or hardest fixtures: each club's coming fixtures and their average difficulty, easiest runs first.

gw_from.description: First gameweek. Leave empty for the next gameweek; set only if the user names one
gw_from.title: Gw From

gw_to.description: Last gameweek. Leave empty for a 6-gameweek view (max 8 ahead)
gw_to.title: Gw To

tools.name: get_price_changes
tools.description: Use this for FPL price rises and falls: players likely to change price tonight, or changes already made this gameweek.

view.description: tonight (default): likely changes tonight; recent: changes made this gameweek
view.title: View

tools.name: get_penalty_takers
tools.description: Use this to find who takes penalties, corners and free kicks for Premier League clubs in FPL, with each penalty taker's chance of being his club's main taker.

tools.name: get_best_chip_squad
tools.description: Use this when someone wants the best FPL Wildcard or Free Hit squad for any gameweek, or the best FPL team right now, built by fplcopilot's optimiser within £100m and FPL squad rules. Not for a Bench Boost team or when to play a chip: the result links fplcopilot's Chip Strategies for that.

chip.description: wildcard or free_hit (bench_boost and triple_captain, played on the manager's own team, return where to plan them)
chip.title: Chip

tools.name: get_mini_league
tools.description: Use this for an FPL mini-league or a manager's rivals in it: standings, the gap to the leader, and rivals' captains and differential picks. Without a league ID it lists the manager's leagues to choose from.

team_id.description: The manager's FPL team ID (entry ID), or any FPL link containing /entry/<id>/. Leave empty if unknown.
team_id.title: Team Id

league_id.description: Mini-league ID, or the FPL league standings link. Leave empty to list the manager's leagues.
league_id.title: League Id

tools.name: get_mini_league_odds
tools.description: Use this when an FPL manager asks their chances (or odds) of winning their mini-league: each manager's win and top-3 probability from 5,000 simulations of the rest of the season.

league_id.description: Mini-league ID, or the FPL league standings link. Leave empty to list the manager's leagues.
league_id.title: League Id

team_id.description: The manager's FPL team ID (entry ID), or any FPL link containing /entry/<id>/. Leave empty if unknown.
team_id.title: Team Id

tools.name: get_gameweek_review
tools.description: Use this to review an FPL manager's gameweek: points vs the average, captain result, bench points and transfers, plus how lucky their season has been against fplcopilot's expected points.

team_id.description: The manager's FPL team ID (entry ID), or any FPL link containing /entry/<id>/. Leave empty if unknown.
team_id.title: Team Id

tools.name: get_deadline
tools.description: Use this for the next Fantasy Premier League deadline time and gameweek.

tools.name: get_predicted_lineups
tools.description: Use this for predicted Premier League starting XIs and team news for the next FPL gameweek (who starts, who is injured or rotated), from fplcopilot's expected minutes.

tools.name: search_guides
tools.description: Use this for Fantasy Premier League rules and how-to questions (scoring, free transfers, chips and when to play them, DefCon, FDR) and fplcopilot's guides: gameweek tips, chip guides, penalty takers, fixtures. FPL's rules change each season (free transfers now roll over up to 5), so use these, not memory.

query.description: What to look for, e.g. 'bench boost' or 'GW7 tips'
query.title: Query

tools.name: read_guide
tools.description: Use this to read one fplcopilot Fantasy Premier League guide in full, by its slug or its fplcopilot.com/blog/ link.

slug.description: The guide's slug, or its fplcopilot.com/blog/ link
slug.title: Slug

tools.name: create_share_link
tools.description: App-only. The fplcopilot card's Share button calls this with the card's share token; it publishes that card, as this server made it, to a public fplcopilot.com page and returns the link. Nothing else can be published.

token.description: The share token of a card this server made
token.title: Token

tools.name: get_player_breakdown
tools.description: App-only. The fplcopilot card calls this when the user taps a player, to open that player's card: expected points by gameweek and by source (minutes, goals, assists, clean sheets, bonus), fixtures and news.

tools.name: get_player_breakdowns
tools.description: App-only. The fplcopilot card calls this as it opens, to load the player cards of the players it shows, so a tap opens one at once.

tools.name: get_manager_squad
tools.description: App-only. The mini-league card calls this when the user taps a rival, to show that manager's squad on a pitch.
